title: Practice: Much, many, few, how many, several

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The temperature was below freezing for several days.
exercises.why: **несколько дней** — несколько with something you can count takes the genitive plural (день → дней).

exercises.q: Като задал ему много ___ (вопрос) о США.
exercises.prompt: Kato asked him many questions about the United States.
exercises.why: **много вопросов** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (вопрос → вопросов).

exercises.prompt: How many squats can you do?
exercises.why: **сколько приседаний** — сколько with something you can count takes the genitive plural (приседание → приседаний).

exercises.prompt: There were many mosquitoes in the room.
exercises.why: **много москитов** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (москит → москитов).

exercises.prompt: I meet a lot of people.
exercises.why: **много людей** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (plural люди → людей).

exercises.prompt: Asians eat a lot of rice.
exercises.why: **много риса** — много with something you cannot count (rice, jam, water) takes the genitive singular (рис → риса).

exercises.prompt: How much jam did you buy?
exercises.why: **сколько джема** — сколько with something you cannot count (rice, jam, water) takes the genitive singular (джем → джема).

exercises.q: Несколько ___ (садовник) заботится об азалиях в парке.
exercises.prompt: Several gardeners look after the azaleas in the park.
exercises.why: **несколько садовников** — несколько with something you can count takes the genitive plural (садовник → садовников).

exercises.prompt: A lot of water has flowed under the bridge since.
exercises.why: **много воды** — много with something you cannot count (rice, jam, water) takes the genitive singular (вода → воды).

exercises.prompt: How many aircraft carriers does the US Navy have?
exercises.why: **сколько авианосцев** — сколько with something you can count takes the genitive plural (авианосец → авианосцев).
**много сувениров** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (сувенир → сувениров).

exercises.prompt: Why are so many people xenophobic?
exercises.why: **много ксенофобов** — много with something you can count takes the genitive plural (ксенофоб → ксенофобов).
